hypothesis: A bounded learned raw-input recurrent state former selected only from historical replay can beat the frozen R46 hand-designed alpha=0.5 recurrent formation baseline on three sealed unseen manifests without increasing inference-state size, readout capacity, or the fixed adaptation budget.

families.grouping: all six raw statistics share one alpha

candidate_search.training_only_data: exact R46 historical transfer/third/fourth/fifth manifests; no fifteenth/sixteenth/seventeenth outcome access
candidate_search.selection: deterministic leave-one-historical-manifest-out replay score = pairwise winner accuracy - fixed complexity penalty; lexicographic tie break
candidate_search.failure_history: all four candidate identities, learned alpha values, historical scores, complexity/resource eligibility, and final unseen classifications retained in result evidence
candidate_search.dream_rsi_replay: R46 and earlier frozen historical outcomes may be replayed; unexplored outcomes are never synthesized

resource_envelope.resource_telemetry: reuse Wingless resources host/process telemetry; exact user hardware is not assumed

frozen_evaluation.supported: valid; selected candidate is resource-eligible at equal/lower effective inference cost; learned pairwise winner accuracy exceeds R46 baseline by >=0.05; learned wins on >=2/3 unseen manifests; learned mean decision regret <=0.90*R46 baseline
frozen_evaluation.mixed: valid; support false; learned accuracy exceeds R46 baseline by >=0.015; learned wins on >=2/3 manifests; learned regret < baseline; or best mechanism is scientifically stronger but resource-ineligible
frozen_evaluation.negative: valid and neither supported nor mixed
